zg361_we_m245_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m245_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m245_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m245_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 245 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m245_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m245_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m245_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m245_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m245_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_record_overtime_245
				has_variable = zg361_we_m245_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m245_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m245_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ab_owner
			var:zg361_we_m245_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ab_subject
			var:zg361_we_m245_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m245_write_case = var:zg361_case_ab_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m245_write_state = var:zg361_case_ab_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m245_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_object_overtime_claim
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_resource_capacity
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_resource_overtime
						}
					var:zg361_we_m245_object_type_code = 245
					var:zg361_we_m245_consumer_contract = 245
					var:zg361_we_m245_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m245_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m245_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m245_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m245_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m245_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m245_object_case = var:zg361_we_m245_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m245_object_state = var:zg361_we_m245_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m245_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m245_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m245_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m245_debt_type_code = 245
					var:zg361_we_m245_debt_consumer_contract = 245
					var:zg361_we_m245_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m245_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m245_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m245_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m245_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m245_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m245_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m245_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m245_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m245_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m245_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m245_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m245_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m245_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m245_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m245_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m245_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m245_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m245_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m245_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m245_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m245_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m245_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m245_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m245_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m245_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m245_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m245_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_record_overtime_245 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m245_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m245_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_consumer_record_overtime_245 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ab_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

	else_if = {

						has_variable = zg361_we_operation_used
					}
					var:zg361_we_operation_used < var:zg361_we_operation_total
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 2453 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } # typed RED, no receipt or business write
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ab_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ab_subject
